prompt:
Hyper-realistic documentary photograph, shot on 35mm Kodak Ektachrome — fine natural grain, muted cool-neutral colour, naturalistic daylight only, no lens flares, calm observational tone.

Scene: the same place and the same high camera position as the first reference image, but years earlier on an ordinary overcast weekday: the supermarket car park is in normal use, nearly every bay filled with parked cars, a few shoppers pushing trolleys between the rows, the glazed barrel-roofed trolley shelter in front of the store, the green store fascia reading Waitrose. In one bay near the trolley shelter stands a single small blue and grey dome tent, the only thing out of place.

Camera: high, looking down across the whole car park towards the store front, wide, deep focus.

Lighting: flat overcast daylight, wet tarmac after rain.

Details: fine natural grain, ordinary and unstyled. No readable lettering except the store fascia.

Compose for a 16:9 frame.

Thanks.
why: Kai r1: a zoomed-out shot of the whole Waitrose car park, full of cars, the twin of the ending's wide
